name: Tougou Kazane
source:
Kazane is [url=/c72477]Rina[/url]'s cousin, [url=/c72476]Touka[/url]'s childhood friend and cousin and the childhood friend of [url=/c72474]Aya[/url] and [url=/c82292]Kanata[/url]. Very close to Kanata when they were very young many found them inseparable and jokingly said that they made a pretty little couple. With a strong sense of responsibility, she is very active in the life of the school. 

When Kanata returned to town, Kazane didn't recognize him when Kanata recognized her at first sight. For unknown reasons, Kazane does not welcome Kanata very friendly, but rather neutral, which Kanata does not really understand because they were rather close as children.

Being cold with him, Kazane is logically not really the most friendly towards Kanata of all the girls in the house. However, Kazane realizes that she may not be the only girl who has eyes on him...
